logical_scope.assumption_translation: The three closed local hypotheses become three distinctly named retained axioms in the flat request. Each assumption command becomes the corresponding axiom command; other literal recipes and all ordered prior references remain unchanged. This is valid under \(I.2\cup\Gamma\), not an unconditional theorem or an automatic universal closure.
logical_scope.closure: Recipient signature remains closed nullary constants with declared Point/Line/Incident arities. The hypothesis names are distinct and disjoint from I.2-uniqueness; duplicate hypothesis occurrences/ports must still retain order and multiplicity.
logical_scope.no_hidden_discharge: Removing local hypotheses requires a separately verified deduction/closure transformation. The proposal explicitly leaves that out of scope.
logical_scope.finite_vs_shared: The 217-formula, 229-recipe, 24-row recipient model is a finite search language; it is not the fixed shared Wang palette. A one-way complete request encoding does not establish a bijection with arbitrary shared-palette proofs or GCTS search equivalence.

design_safety.certificate: A discovered full point certificate must be sorted by logical row, retain every primitive/padding occurrence, reconstruct full decorated identities/markings and exact strict-prior ordered MP premises, and pass both local and flat logical checking.
design_safety.native_boundary: Any later native run needs exact fixed/free/input serialization, 43 physical band heads/capacities, true parser start, pinned tables and full response replay. Blank-resource changes remain explicit. Cropped tiles cannot be acceptance evidence.
design_safety.ordering: The prospective fixed order uses generic local source selection/readiness/novelty and returns a full permutation at the mandatory scheduler point. It is not RL, a pruning lemma or a supplied target proof. Empty descriptors avoid using the authored witness or root-composed family as a target proposal.
design_safety.unknown_exhaustion: Every unknown child must restore paired state and stop without parent exclusion; exclusion needs independently reconstructed complete child exhaustion. Finite 24-row exhaustion cannot imply unrestricted nonprovability.
